name: urbanloop
description: Find and manage UrbanLoop signage content, schedules and display settings from your conversation.

interface.longDescription: Find your UrbanLoop slides, playlists and TVs. Save files created in chat, review edits with retained originals, and choose where to use them. Add playlists to TVs, manage schedules and review single-TV or group settings changes. Access follows your current UrbanLoop role and sites. Shared edits can affect other uses; the app shows their impact before saving. Requires an eligible UrbanLoop account. Account administration and social-post publishing are outside this integration. Native file import supports static PNG/JPEG/WebP, PDF and MP4 within size and processing limits.
capabilities: Review file edits and retained versions
defaultPrompt: Show my TVs and their playlists.
Save this poster and help me add it to a playlist.
Show the calendar for my Welcome playlist.

positive.prompt: Show Acceptance Lobby TV (synthetic), all its assigned playlists and the Welcome slide. Open the calendar for Welcome playlist — library only for November 16–22, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only currently accessible content. Show every assigned playlist, useful previews and configured schedules. Do not claim that a saved assignment proves physical playback. Browsing makes no content or TV changes.

positive.description: Create a file and explicitly place it on signage
positive.prompt: Save this attached welcome poster as New reviewer welcome poster, explicitly create a files slide named New reviewer welcome slide, then save a New reviewer welcome playlist and add it to Acceptance Lobby TV (synthetic) after I review it. Keep the TV’s existing playlists.
positive.tools_triggered: import_asset_file, get_asset_draft, preview_asset_save, save_asset_edit, create_slide_from_asset, preview_playlist_save, save_playlist, preview_existing_publication, publish_to_screens
positive.expected_behavior: File import and first Save do not automatically create a slide. Explicit placement creates the selected slide and playlist. Reviewed TV assignment adds that playlist and preserves all existing playlists. Repeating the same Save request creates no duplicates.

positive.description: Edit one file with its original retained
positive.prompt: Use the attached updated poster for the first image in Welcome. Show the current and proposed files and affected uses, then wait for my confirmation before saving it to the same file.
positive.expected_behavior: Show current and proposed files and shared impact. Advance the same Asset after confirmation, retain its original, update following usages, preserve fixed versions, all other slide items, schedules and playlist/TV membership. Do not duplicate the whole slide.

positive.description: Schedule a playlist and inspect its calendar
positive.prompt: Schedule “Welcome playlist — library only” for Monday through Friday next week, 9am to 5pm. Confirm exact dates and local wall-clock times, show the review, then save after I approve and show its calendar.
positive.expected_behavior: Clarify dates/time interpretation when missing. Review exact target, recurrence and impact before Save. Preserve unrelated schedules and TV assignments, and show the stored result with the selected range.

positive.description: Change and undo settings on a TV group
positive.prompt: Show the All TVs in organization group settings. Review changing only automatic slide advance to 17 seconds, save when I confirm, then let me undo it. Preserve mixed orientation/transition and every other setting.
positive.tools_triggered: list_screen_groups, get_screen_group, preview_screen_group_settings, apply_screen_settings, get_screen_settings_change, restore_screen_settings
positive.expected_behavior: Show mixed values truthfully and review the exact accessible group members. Report paged progress and per-TV failures; complete all required steps without presenting partial completion as success. Undo preserves any newer conflicting edit.

negative.description: Account administration is outside this integration. Explain the limitation; do not invoke content, publication or settings writes as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Invite a new colleague to my UrbanLoop organization and grant them access to Lobby TV.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that user invitations and account/site administration are not available through this UrbanLoop integration. Direct the user to the ordinary management app. Do not send an invitation, change access or claim that it was done.

negative.description: Social posting is outside this signage integration. Do not invoke UrbanLoop write tools or report a social-post result.
negative.prompt: Publish the Welcome poster to Instagram and Facebook and start a weekly social campaign.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connection manages signage content and does not publish social posts or manage campaigns. Do not create a TV assignment as a substitute, post to a social account, or claim that a campaign was scheduled.

negative.description: OS installation is outside the exposed TV content/settings controls. Do not invoke a settings change as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Install the latest tvOS update on every TV in the Lobby group.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the integration controls supported signage content/settings and cannot install tvOS or manage operating-system updates. Do not alter orientation, schedules or playlists, initiate an unexposed device action, or claim an update completed.

review.commerce_description: This integration uses existing UrbanLoop accounts. It does not sell products, process payments, or start subscriptions inside ChatGPT.
prompts: Show my TVs and their playlists.
Save this poster and help me add it to a playlist.
Show the calendar for my Welcome playlist.

publication.release_notes: Initial UrbanLoop integration for finding signage content, saving reusable files with retained originals and bounded history, explicit slide/playlist placement, additive TV assignments, schedules, and reviewed TV/group settings. Current UrbanLoop roles and sites apply.
